question_pt: Como as internacoes se distribuem por carater de internacao?
sql: SELECT c.DESCRICAO AS carater, COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN car_int c ON i.CAR_INT = c.CAR_INT GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY internacoes DESC
